import codecs
text = 'A\u0080\u4e2d\U0001f600Z'
for encoding in ('utf_8', 'utf_8_sig', 'utf_7', 'utf_16_le', 'utf_16_be', 'utf_32_le', 'utf_32_be'):
    data = text.encode(encoding)
    for split in range(len(data) + 1):
        decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)()
        prefix = decoder.decode(data[:split], False)
        state = decoder.getstate()
        replay = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)()
        replay.setstate(state)
        assert prefix + decoder.decode(data[split:], True) == text
        assert prefix + replay.decode(data[split:], True) == text
        decoder.reset()
        assert decoder.decode(data, True) == text
    print(encoding, len(data) + 1)
failure = ValueError('decoder callback')
def fail(error):
    raise failure
codecs.register_error('user-failure', fail)
try:
    codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf_8')('user-failure').decode(b'\xff', True)
except ValueError as error:
    assert error is failure
else:
    assert False
def inner(error):
    assert (error.object, error.start, error.end) == (b'\xffA', 0, 1)
    return (input(), -1)
def outer(error):
    assert (error.object, error.start, error.end) == (b'\xe2\x82', 0, 2)
    nested = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('ascii')('inner')
    return (nested.decode(b'\xffA', True), error.end)
codecs.register_error('inner', inner)
codecs.register_error('outer', outer)
decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf_8')('outer')
assert decoder.decode(b'\xe2', False) == ''
assert decoder.decode(b'\x82', True) == '?A'
assert decoder.getstate() == (b'', 0)
print('recovery verified')
